traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria and requirements for Story 021.0-DEV-TEST-ANNOTATION-AUTO-FIX are fully implemented and verified: - File-level `@supports` templates with clear placeholders and TODO guidance are inserted automatically when missing, controlled by autoFixTestTemplate and testSupportsTemplate. - Malformed `[REQ-XXX]` prefixes in test names are normalized in a safe, format-only manner (spacing, underscores, parentheses, and casing) via normalizeReqPrefixInDescription and normalizeReqId, with fixes applied only when an existing REQ-like identifier is present. - Existing formatting (test code, string literal quoting, shebang) is preserved, and only comments and name string prefixes are modified. - No semantic inference is attempted: when there is no recognizable REQ prefix, the rule reports an error without providing a fixer. - Behavior is documented in user-docs/api-reference.md, and dedicated tests in tests/rules/require-test-traceability.test.ts validate both auto-fix scenarios and no-fix safety conditions. All these tests currently pass in the Jest test run.
Based on this concrete evidence, the story is fully satisfied.
